instruction: Follow artists of all the songs and albums I have ever liked on Spotify.
notes: Single-app Spotify task with no answer. The actual numbers of liked songs, liked albums and artists are unknown before execution, so the problem uses placeholder entities (2 liked songs, 2 liked albums, one artist each); at runtime the agent instantiates one show_song/show_album per liked item (paginating show_liked_songs/show_liked_albums over page_index) and one follow_artist per distinct artist id. Listing actions assert nullary (liked-songs-listed)/(liked-albums-listed) facts that gate inspection of the statically declared liked items; show_song/show_album carry the artist as an extra non-API parameter so that their effect (known-id ?ar) records the discovered artist id (a song/album with several artists is modeled by several such facts). follow_artist requires (known-id ?ar) and (not (following ?ar)), so only artists derived from liked items are followed and duplicates across songs/albums are followed once, matching the evaluation (newly followed set == union of song/album artists, nothing removed). Because the set of artists is problem-specific and quantified preconditions are disallowed, supervisor-complete-task cannot enumerate the per-artist (following ...) goal facts in the domain; its precondition requires both listings and (not (task-completed)), while every other action requires (not (task-completed)), so any plan reaching the problem goal ends with complete_task. Login username is the supervisor email from show_profile; password from show_account_passwords.
